--- a/art/character/moss_monk.art
+++ b/art/character/moss_monk.art
@@ -4,1 +4,2 @@
 @target character/moss_monk_yawn.png 1024x1024 as:yawn
+@target character/moss_monk_sleepy.png 1024x1024 as:sleepy

--- a/art/character/moss_monk.art
+++ b/art/character/moss_monk.art
@@ -171,2 +171,3 @@
-    curve 512+120*s,362 512+92*s,348 512+60*s,354 stroke:fade(skin.line .7),[2 5 2] taper:.35
-    eye 104x112 iris:iris side:s look:0,.4 lid:if target == blink then 1 else .6 at:512+88*s,440
+    let brow_drop = if target == sleepy then 1 else 0
+    curve 512+120*s,362+14*brow_drop 512+92*s,348+18*brow_drop 512+60*s,354+6*brow_drop stroke:fade(skin.line .7),[2 5 2] taper:.35
+    eye 104x112 iris:iris side:s look:0,.4 lid:if target == blink then 1 else if target == sleepy then .86 else .6 at:512+88*s,440

--- a/art/character/moss_monk.art
+++ b/art/character/moss_monk.art
@@ -176,1 +176,3 @@
     o_mouth 36 at:512,508 color:monk.mouth
+  else if target == sleepy
+    smile 26 at:512,514 color:monk.mouth

--- a/art/character/moss_monk.art
+++ b/art/character/moss_monk.art
@@ -223,1 +223,11 @@
   sparkle 26 at:318,222 color:monk.star
+if target == sleepy
+  layer sleep_bubble
+    ellipse 14,9 at:292,338 fill:monk.star
+    ellipse 24,15 at:258,302 fill:monk.star
+    ellipse 72,48 at:208,242 fill:monk.star name:bubble
+      ellipse 22,12 at:-16,-10 fill:glint a:.82 blur:2
+      ellipse 34,14 at:8,12 fill:monk.shadow a:.12 blur:6
+      curve -22,-10 18,-10 stroke:monk.shadow,[2.2 4.4 2.2] taper:.35
+      curve 18,-10 -16,8 stroke:monk.shadow,[2.2 4.4 2.2] taper:.35
+      curve -16,8 20,8 stroke:monk.shadow,[2.2 4.4 2.2] taper:.35
